notes: Synthetic graduation policy for the FIT HANU Bachelor of IT programme. Both rules must hold for the `graduated` proposition to be entailed. This is fictional educational data, not real HANU regulations.

rules.description: Graduation from FIT HANU Bachelor of IT requires a total of at least 135 credits accumulated across all years.
Graduation requires all mandatory courses in the IT programme to be completed.
Graduation requires English exit clearance: CEFR C1 or IELTS >= 6.0 (represented by completing ENG301 or holding a certified exemption).
